verdict.rationale: Per-token pricing is a fair question for an LLM model family, since a vendor could run a hosted API with a public rate card, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party per-token price list. It only shows downloadable open weights and third-party partner hosting (AWS, Azure, Groq, and others), and partner pricing would be host-platform pricing, not Llama's own.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every current model without talking to sales
